bio: Randall Kekoa Quinones Akee is the newly appointed Julie Johnson Kidd Professor of Indigenous Governance and Development and the new faculty director of the Project on Indigenous Governance and Development at Harvard Kennedy School. This newly endowed position was made possible through the generosity of the Endeavor Foundation.
